results.title: Moderna reports positive Phase 3 topline data for mRNA-1283 next-gen COVID booster
results.text: Moderna (NASDAQ: MRNA) announced positive Phase 3 topline data today for its next-generation COVID-19 vaccine candidate mRNA-1283. The Phase 3 trial met its primary endpoint with statistical significance over the comparator. Safety profile was consistent with prior studies; no new serious adverse events were reported. The DSMB did not recommend any protocol amendment.

results.title: FDA accepts BLA for Vertex's CASGEVY label expansion, PDUFA date set for Q4 2026
results.text: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today accepted Vertex Pharmaceuticals' BLA for a label expansion of CASGEVY into beta thalassemia subpopulations. A PDUFA date has been set for Q4 2026. The company indicated AdCom is not expected. The submission includes confirmatory overall survival data from the pivotal trial.

results.title: Vertex announces $500M convertible note offering to fund pipeline programs
results.text: Vertex Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: VRTX) today announced a $500 million convertible note offering. Proceeds will fund continued development of VX-548 and the company's broader pipeline. The company stated cash runway remains strong following the financing, with no going-concern issues.

results.title: Senate moves IRA negotiation expansion bill out of committee, second tranche of drugs named
results.text: The Senate Finance Committee voted to advance legislation expanding the IRA negotiation list. The inflation rebate trigger thresholds would be lowered under the proposal. Industry groups warned of Part D redesign knock-on effects across pharma.

results.title: Short interest in biotech sector hits 18-month high amid FDA budget uncertainty
results.text: Aggregate short interest across biotech tickers climbed to an 18-month high last week, with several names showing days-to-cover exceeding 8. Unusual options activity was observed in mid-cap biotech ahead of an expected government shutdown vote that could affect FDA budget allocation.
